Pushed to `main` (commit subject "Aggregation to tidy result CSVs..."):
  > 
  > - `results/datasets.csv`, `results/spectra.csv`, `results/helm_mmlu_binomial_floor.csv` (C0: Table 1, Fig. A1) — final unless I say otherwise.
  > - `results/theory.csv`, `results/theory_gap.csv` — tiers `true`, `fitted`, `bootstrap` are final-form; tier `real` rows appear when the grouped runs finish.
  > - `curves/refs/closure/kstar/gap/bias.csv` are generated by `code/aggregate.py` once the 200-draw runs (~1 h) finish; I will push them then.
  > 
  > Things your panels need to know: (1) **target set**: the primary design holds out a fixed random 30% of the columns as targets T (identical for all selectors/k) and selects S from the other 70%; `design=allrest` is the literal "R = P \ S" problem (only random and greedyA). Say which design a panel shows. (2) `closure.csv` uses mean *squared* standardised error. (3) `kstar.csv` has `censored` and `grid_max`; k grid is 1..10, 12, 15, 20, 30 (capped at N/2). (4) `refs.csv`: `lobo` = the better of FA-conditioning and Ledoit-Wolf-conditioning LOBO (`lobo_source` row says which); `insample` is the optimistic reference; `binomial` only for helm_mmlu. (5) p-values in `gap.csv` are bootstrap two-sided; `p_boot=0` means < 1/2000. (6) Time-forward uses MTEB `release_date` (first-commit date is bulk-dominated: 61-63% of pool models in one commit). All numbers carry no uncertainty unless a ci column says so.
